create_svr_rbf_model: create an SVR model with RBF kernel for 1D regression on noisy sine data
create_svr_linear_model: create an SVR model with linear kernel for 1D regression on noisy sine data
create_svr_polynomial_model: create an SVR model with polynomial kernel for 1D regression on noisy sine data
